eyebrow: Four questions, asked in this order
Every crossing is a place an attacker looks first
Six categories to check against each boundary
code:
S  Spoofing              — fake a user or service
T  Tampering             — modify data in transit/at rest
R  Repudiation           — deny an action, no audit trail
I  Information disclosure — see data you shouldn't
D  Denial of service     — make it unavailable
E  Elevation of privilege — gain capabilities you shouldn't
caption: STRIDE, applied to Northbridge's checkout service — cheapest to fix while it's still a whiteboard decision.

subtitle: Who, and what service, gets to touch checkout at all.
